name: MEI Industrial Solutions Providence
old_description: Formerly known as Accurate Metal Sales & Fabrication, MEI provides retail metal sales and custom metal fabrication, sub-assemblies and weldments to the general public as well as the commercial construction industry, municipalities and residential general contractors. Our capabilities include 3D engineered drawings, design renderings, manufacturing, structural repairs, complex weldments, rigging and installation of finished product. All our welders are AWS D1.1 structural certified as well as MIL certified for military and defense contracts. We use advanced tools such as CNC plasma cutting to fabricate high quality weldments to meet our client’s exact requirements and delivery deadlines.
about:
MEI Industrial Solutions operates from Southbridge, Massachusetts, where it runs a fabrication facility and retail metal shop. The business was formerly known as Accurate Metal Sales & Fabrication before adopting its current name.

The company provides custom metal fabrication, including sub-assemblies, weldments, structural repairs, and complex weldments, alongside retail sales of structural steel shapes. Its in-house design team uses SolidWorks and AutoCAD to produce 3D engineered drawings and conceptual blueprints. Fabrication processes cover MIG, TIG, and stick welding, CNC plasma cutting, oxyacetylene and plasma torch cutting, drilling, grinding, beveling, jigging, fit-up, and assembly. Equipment includes a high-definition plasma table cutting up to 1.5-inch mild steel, a hydraulic shear for 3/4-inch plate, a press brake bending 1/2-inch by 10-foot lengths, roll forms, an ironworker, and various welding machines. Services are offered both in-house and on-site, with rigging and installation of finished products.

MEI serves the commercial construction industry, municipal governments, residential general contractors, and the general public. Its welders hold AWS D1.1 structural certification and MIL certification for military and defense contracts, allowing the shop to take on defense-related work.

The company emphasizes its certified welding staff and advanced CNC plasma cutting as key differentiators, aiming to meet exact client requirements and delivery deadlines. Its retail operation sells metal with no minimum quantity, accommodating orders from a single piece to full truckloads.

name: MGM Transformers (a Forgent company)
old_description: Dry-type and liquid-filled distribution/power transformers (cast coil, VPI, padmount)
about:
MGM Transformers, based in Vernon, California, has been designing and building transformers since 1974. The company operates as a subsidiary of Forgent, a platform that brings together over 100 years of experience in power infrastructure.

The company manufactures dry-type transformers using vacuum pressure impregnation (VPI) and cast coil epoxy resin processes, as well as liquid-filled padmount and substation transformers. It also produces power distribution unit (PDU) transformers for data centers and general-purpose low-voltage transformers. Operations span five advanced production facilities totaling 1.5 million square feet across California, Texas, and Tijuana, Mexico, with a vertically integrated manufacturing model and approximately 1,500 employees.

MGM Transformers serves data centers from hyperscale to edge deployments, grid modernization projects including solar, storage, and utility-scale infrastructure, and industrial manufacturing facilities requiring process loads, electrification, and plant resilience. Its transformers are also used in commercial, industrial, and utility applications; a noted customer is Standard Solar, which received a grounding transformer in four weeks.

The company emphasizes vertically integrated manufacturing, custom design capability for specific voltage, footprint, and performance requirements, and a rush-order program called Bull Rush. It reports a 98% on-time delivery rate and an installed base valued at $4 billion.

name: MMR Group, Inc.
old_description: MMR Group consistently ranks at the top of Engineering News-Record's annual specialty contractors list. We're no stranger to 1 million work-hour projects, and we manage 30 offices throughout North and South America.
about:
MMR Group, Inc. is headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and operates 30 offices across North and South America. The company employs approximately 725 people and consistently ranks at the top of Engineering News-Record's specialty contractors list.

The firm provides a multi-disciplined suite of services including electrical construction, instrumentation, power distribution, panel and modular control building fabrication, telecommunications and security systems, commissioning and start-up, power development, maintenance, and mission critical construction. MMR self-performs electrical, telecommunications, security, fire alarm, and gas services to reduce cycle times and cost per megawatt. A Modular Systems facility in Lafayette, Louisiana, supports off-site data-center skid assembly.

MMR serves chemical and petrochemical, oil and gas (upstream, midstream, downstream), industrial manufacturing, power generation, power development, renewable energy and energy storage, and telecommunications and security sectors. Clients include Black Hills Energy (Cheyenne Prairie natural-gas turbine project), Kinder Morgan (Elba Island 35kV/15kV), Shell Canada (Albian Oil Sands), Procter & Gamble (tissue machine plant), GE/Entergy (Perryville blackstart storage), and Chevron (Big Foot platform).

The company cites its diverse expertise, commitment to safety, quality, and client satisfaction, and the ability to complete projects on schedule and within budget as key differentiators. Since inception, MMR has demonstrated competency across broad sectors, combining state-of-the-art project controls, cutting-edge technology, and certified craftsmen to deliver critical infrastructure.

old_description: MRL Equipment Co. Inc. has manufactured pavement marking, removal, grooving, and pavement maintenance equipment for over 36 years. Founded by road stripers with first-hand knowledge and background in striping and removal operations, MRL innovates with the customer to produce customized paint, thermoplastic, plural component, line removal/pavement grooving, water blasting, bituminous marking equipment and more.
about:
MRL Equipment Company operates from Billings, Montana, where it has manufactured pavement marking, removal, grooving, and pavement maintenance equipment for over 36 years. The business was founded by road stripers who brought first-hand knowledge of striping and removal operations to the design of their machines. No explicit founding year or ownership structure beyond the founders' background is disclosed.

The company produces a range of specialized trucks and systems for road marking and surface preparation. Its product line includes thermoplastic trucks with 12,000 lb and 16,000 lb capacity, the EpoxyPro™ plural component impingement material mixing system, multiple-head progressive removal and grooving trucks, and road marking and raised pavement marker (RPM) application equipment. The firm also offers parts, support, and retrofit services for existing fleets. Facility size, headcount, and annual production volumes are not publicly stated.

Primary customers are pavement marking contractors, road striping companies, and pavement maintenance firms — essentially the same professionals who founded the business. The equipment is built for high-volume output, serviceability, and ease of operation in striping, removal, grooving, and raised marker applications across highway and roadway projects.

MRL positions its differentiation on the founders' direct field experience, which drives customized solutions for paint, thermoplastic, plural component, water blasting, and bituminous marking applications. The company emphasizes minimal surface damage during removal, high-volume thermoplastic capacity, and equipment designed for the specific workflow of striping crews.

name: Mace MFG
old_description: In 2023, I took a leap of faith and founded Mace Manufacturing. My tinkering on nights and weekends began with 3D printers and CNC routers. This eventually evolved into acquiring a CNC plasma table to design and fabricate a replacement floor for my 1974 Toyota Land Cruiser. As most of you know, as we get older, our tools just get bigger and more expensive. In February of 2023, I decided to sell my dream car, which was a 1993 Nissan Skyline GTR, to purchase a HAAS VF2 and challenge myself to develop unique and innovative automotive machined accessories.
about:
Mace MFG is based in Indian Land, South Carolina, and was founded in 2023 by Stuart, a mechanical engineer with a background in automotive design and manufacturing. The venture began with nights-and-weekends tinkering using 3D printers and CNC routers, followed by a CNC plasma table to fabricate a replacement floor for a 1974 Toyota Land Cruiser. In February 2023, the founder sold a 1993 Nissan Skyline GT-R to purchase a HAAS VF2 vertical machining center and focus on developing machined automotive accessories.

The company produces precision CNC-machined accessories for off-road Toyota and Lexus vehicles. Its product line includes billet aluminum volume knobs, titanium-and-Ultem key fob cases, polycarbonate-and-Ultem key fob cases, battery tie-downs, shift knobs, drive-mode knobs, front bump stops, rail T-nuts, and battery clamp J-hooks. Manufacturing is centered on the HAAS VF2, supplemented by earlier capabilities in CNC routing, 3D printing, and plasma cutting. Materials used are 6061 aluminum, titanium, Ultem (PEI), and polycarbonate.

Mace MFG serves the automotive aftermarket and overlanding communities, targeting owners of Toyota 4Runner, Tundra, Tacoma, Sequoia, and Lexus GX, LX, and FJ Cruiser models. Sales are direct-to-consumer through the company’s e-commerce site, which offers model-specific fitment. The site also highlights collaborations with other independent makers such as Charvonia Design, Perry Parts, and Teton Workshop.

The business was started to create unique, innovative machined accessories that combine American-made quality with adventurous design. The founder emphasizes engineering-driven development, scrutinizing every detail to deliver rugged gear with reliable performance and no compromise on quality.

name: Machined In Wood
old_description: Machined In Wood is a custom CNC woodworking shop that specializes in CNC machined wood projects, laser engraving, and finishing of custom one of a kind pieces, prototypes, and small to medium scale manufacturing.
about:
Machined In Wood operates from Bellingham, Massachusetts. The shop began as a small, home-based business and has since expanded to serve both individual clients and commercial manufacturers. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in public sources.

The company provides custom CNC woodworking, laser engraving, and finishing services. Its equipment includes two 48" x 48" CNC routers (one with pass-through capability), a horizontal boring machine, CO2 and diode laser engravers, and a 3D printer. Traditional woodworking tools such as a table saw, band saw, jointer, planer, drum sander, and router complement the digital fabrication. They handle production runs from dozens to hundreds of parts and maintain a 1% tolerance level with rigorous quality inspections.

Customers range from hobbyists and local wood shops to engineers and commercial firms requiring prototyping or small-to-medium scale manufacturing. The shop works with wood, plastic, acrylic, and aluminum, and offers painting and finishing including hand painting, airbrushing, HVLP, spar urethane, polyurethane, and nitrocellulose lacquer for musical instruments. They do not produce epoxy river tables or large-scale cabinetry.

Machined In Wood differentiates itself by investing in specialized equipment like the horizontal boring machine and large-format flattening capacity, allowing it to take on smaller, complex jobs that larger shops decline. The team emphasizes nearly two decades of experience collaborating with engineers, proficiency in GD&T, and a policy of not marking up customer-supplied material.

name: Mack Molding Co
old_description: Mack Molding specializes in custom injection molding, providing high-quality plastic components tailored to diverse industry needs.
about:
Mack Molding was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Arlington, Vermont, with additional facilities in East Arlington and Cavendish, Vermont, as well as Inman, South Carolina, and Statesville, North Carolina. The company operates as a vertically integrated contract manufacturer across ten locations totaling more than 1.5 million square feet of manufacturing space.

The company provides custom plastic injection molding from 28- to 4,000-ton presses with shot sizes up to 769 ounces, supporting volumes from five pieces to five million annually. Capabilities include large-part molding, structural foam, gas-assist, and two-shot molding, complemented by in-house tooling, CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication (laser cutting, bending, welding), Class A painting, pad printing, ultrasonic welding, and turnkey electromechanical assembly up to Class III medical devices.

Mack serves customers in the medical, industrial, transportation, robotics, energy and utilities, and defense sectors, ranging from Fortune 500 corporations to private enterprises. Its vertically integrated model allows coordination of plastic and metal components from a single location, reducing lead times and ensuring quality across complex programs.

The company emphasizes financial stability — debt-free with a 5A1 Dun & Bradstreet rating — and positions itself as a single partner with total responsibility, leveraging over a century of experience, ITAR and FDA registrations, and certifications including ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, ISO 14001:2015, and IATF 16949:2016.
